name: Norwegian Atlantic Front Current
error_interpretation: Reported plus/minus statistic; width-specific interpretation awaits corrected supporting Table S1. Adjacent velocity statistics use standard errors. No annual range or confidence level assigned.
geographic_scope: Mohn Ridge Polar Front, not the Svinoy section or whole branch.
layer: Depth-averaged absolute geostrophic jet, constrained by glider depth-average currents from upper-1000-m profiling; no fixed-depth width slab.
boundary_rule: Fit a Gaussian to depth-averaged velocities above half peak; positive poleward integration boundaries within maximum plus/minus two fitted sigma. Theoretical transport coverage is not confidence coverage or FWHM.
source_citation: Bosse and Fer (2019), Mean Structure and Seasonality of the Norwegian Atlantic Front Current Along the Mohn Ridge From Repeated Glider Transects, doi:10.1029/2019GL084723; corrected 2020-09-28.
source_locator: Corrected publisher HTML: sections 2.2-2.4, 3.1-3.2 and erratum.
source_access: Corrected publisher text reviewed. Corrected original PDF and supporting Table S1 not acquired; raw-mission source QA is not paper reproduction.
temporal_interpretation: Published mean-structure width. Source describes seasonal widths as compatible within error bars; numeric seasonal means and annual physical extrema unverified.
